name: world_bank_open_data
description: Query World Bank Open Data for global development indicators, country time series, and economic, social, and environmental metrics through agent-gw.
author: Moonshot AI
skillInstructions: Use the World Bank Open Data skill when the user needs free global development data, national-level country indicators, or time series covering economic, social, or environmental metrics such as GDP, GNP, population, poverty rates, unemployment, trade, inflation, education, health, or environment data. First inspect the datasource description, choose the exact API documented there, build parameters exactly as required, and call the datasource through the bundled script. Do not invent development data when the datasource call fails or returns no result. Include relevant country, indicator, unit, year range, frequency, source, and coverage caveats when the returned content provides them.

interface.shortDescription: Public data from the World Bank on global economic development indicators
interface.longDescription: Query the World Bank Open Data platform for development data across countries and 29,000+ indicators. The datasource covers economic, social, and environmental metrics including GDP, GNP, population, poverty rates, unemployment, trade, inflation, education, health, and environmental data, with national-level time series from 1960 to present where available.
